[Bookmark] Bookmark Management Report and Documentation

Tested by :

QA (Quality Assurance) @ekosy9

Project :

Panorra Mobile @lundara02

Description of Feature :

The "Bookmark Management" feature enables users to organize saved panorama posts into custom folders, browse saved collections, search folders, and manage bookmarks smoothly.

1. Environment & Test Data

Parameter Value
Device Samsung SM-A235F (Android 14)
App Version Panorra Mobile v1.9.44
Test Account @ekosymm

2. Method Coverage & Test Cases
